description: You are an operations manager responsible for securing a sensitive Q4 executive board meeting. Jitsi Meet is available at http://localhost:8080. Join the meeting room named 'Q4ExecutiveBoard'. Once inside, enable the Lobby feature so all incoming participants must be manually approved before entering, and set a meeting password of 'Board2024!' to prevent uninvited access. Copy the meeting invitation link to the clipboard so it can be sent securely to board members. Finally, save a written security summary to /home/ga/Desktop/board_security_summary.txt. The summary must document: the full meeting URL, the security features you enabled (lobby status, password/lock status), and instructions for how board members should request access. This document will be reviewed by the IT security team for compliance.
